positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked across the entire Node.js backend stack improving our backend infrastructure, developing new product features/algorithms, and serving millions of requests for a social dating app with 100k+ DAU
• Engineered a social-network database graph using Neo4j to allow us to develop new features around connectivity, relevance, and personalization amongst users and places
• Architected a natural language/ML search engine using spaCy, PostgreSQL, and ElasticSearch

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built out the entire e-commerce tech stack including microservices, client-side e-commerce website, custom A/B testing, and various internal tools to optimize growth
• Assisted growth team in improving our conversion/acquisition funnel, scaling up to over 3 million dollars in gross sales
• Developed a custom content management system on top of React, Node.js, and Contentful

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Migrated and developed a web-based AI chatbot and chatbot analytics platform for the customer support team
• Created new features for the chatbot to allow the customer service  team to track statistics, log conversations, see improvement rates over time, and a live feed of chatbot interactions

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Teach computer science students basic and intermediate topics in Python
Hold weekly lecture sections where students can bring homework and any computer science related question
Grade coding assignments for code clarity and correctness

positions.title: Sound Engineer
positions.description: Mix live sound for a variety of bands (on-campus and off) including Delicate Steve, Milo, Xenia Rubinos, Photay, and more.

positions.title: Studio Intern
positions.description:
Complete runs for composers and studio employees in a quick and timely manner
Maintain the various buildings on site including cleaning and fixing any present issues
Sit with composers and engineers to learn more about the film scoring process and professional workflows

volunteerExperiences.description: Taught middle school students the fundamentals of music theory and orchestration with final performances by various chamber ensembles and the New York Philharmonic.
